caption: The drawing depicts a single decorative tassel suspended vertically on a plain background. The tassel features a twisted cord at the top in alternating shades of muted pink and yellowish-green, which transitions into a woven spherical element with a diamond pattern. Below this is a section of two bulbous forms stacked vertically, each encircled by vertical bands of muted green and pink with fine detailing. The main body of the tassel consists of multiple hanging strands; thick twisted cords in a dull reddish-purple color alternate with plaited cords in an olive-yellow hue. The entirety of the tassel has intricate textural rendering, with careful attention to the distinct twists and braids of each strand and section. The background is an off-white or beige color, creating stark contrast and emphasizing the central object. The artist's signature and the date "1838" appear in small text in the lower right corner.
title: Curtain Tassel
